title: 車輪付きサイクロン式工房集塵機
description: 木工室・共同工房に据えるサイクロン式集塵機の外観模型。車輪付き支持枠、上部ファン・縦置きモーター、内部を空洞にした円筒と円錐の分離器、実開口の吸込接続口、蓋・取手・留具付き回収容器、接続ダクトと深いひだのフィルター外形を造形。回収容器やフィルターを含む一式1点で、作業機や延長ホースは含みません。送風・分離・ろ過・粉塵対策・荷重や安全性能は実装・検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.075 × 1.829 × 0.730 m、32,416三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A cyclone-extractor appearance prop for woodworking rooms and shared workshops. It includes a wheeled support frame, upper fan and vertical motor, hollow cylindrical/conical separator, genuinely open inlet connection, lidded collection bin with handles/latches, connecting outlet duct and deeply pleated filter exterior. Bin and filter are part of one complete assembly; processing machines and extension hoses are absent. Airflow, separation, filtration, dust protection, loads and safety performance are neither implemented nor validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.075 × 1.829 × 0.730 m; 32,416 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
